## Change / checkpoint

What changed? Is this WIP, a tested fix, or ready for integration?

## Evidence

- [ ] Recorded test results, limitations and the next step below
- [ ] Launcher checks and runtime-tool tests
- [ ] Runtime clean/native CI if patches/build/base/provisioning changed
- [ ] Exact candidate / commit / checksum recorded for manual game tests
- [ ] No credentials, game files, saves, prefixes or raw diagnostics in Git

## Known limitations / next agent

List skipped tests, failures, hypotheses and the exact next safe action.
Do not claim stable release readiness from green unit tests alone.
